items.name: Edge cases
items.description: The unusual cases each feature must handle (empty, too many, wrong order, offline…), listed in the plan and covered by tests

items.name: Components changed and used
items.description: Which parts we change (apps, website, API, database, background jobs…) and which existing parts the feature uses. New feature: "nothing used before" is fine

items.name: Metrics + alerts
items.description: Which errors to count; does it need an alert rule?

items.name: Logs
items.description: What is logged when it fails (never personal data)

items.name: Rollback
items.description: How to undo it: code, database, settings

items.name: Cost
items.description: Money per month, and the Claude cost if notable

items.name: Time
items.description: How long it takes each time it runs, for a new process (e.g. deploy the API: build ~2 min + deploy ~1 min), and whether it beats a cheaper option that only saves that time

items.name: Visual options
items.description: Anything visual: options as pictures, you pick

items.name: Setting instead of hardcoding
items.description: Which values the owner can change without a code change

items.name: Goals and non-goals
items.description: What it must do, and what it deliberately won't

items.name: Open questions
items.description: Everything you must answer, in one round, before work starts

items.name: Tests and their titles
items.description: Which tests by name; bug = failing test first; text change = no test; time added

items.name: Screenshots
items.description: Before / after, each platform, region and language

items.name: Input limits
items.description: Every field: limits, red error with reason, save as draft

items.name: Security
items.description: Who may see or change it; other users' data; abuse limits; tests

items.name: Double taps and retries
items.description: Double press, retry, two devices at once

items.name: Deploy order
items.description: Database → API → apps, each step safe on its own

items.name: When something we depend on is down
items.description: Database host, sign-in, email, push: what the user sees

items.name: Test data
items.description: What seed data local and test environments need

items.name: Accessibility
items.description: Screen reader labels, touch size, contrast

items.name: Docs and roadmap
items.description: Which docs change; follow-ups proposed, never added alone

items.name: Manual checks
items.description: What you check by hand when no test can, with a reminder

items.name: Problem and context
items.description: why now, who hurts, what happens if we do nothing?

items.name: Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then, happy path + edge cases)
items.description: what exact behaviour must a test prove?

items.name: Small and independent (INVEST)
items.description: can it ship alone, in one PR/step, without a blocker?

items.name: Which apps / surfaces / platforms
items.description: which apps, the API, web or mobile, which regions?

items.name: Alternatives considered (short)
items.description: what else did we weigh and why not?

items.name: UX sketch / screen list and copy
items.description: what does each screen show, incl. empty, loading, error states?

items.name: Formal estimate in points / sign-off board
items.description: n/a for 1–2 people.

items.name: API contract
items.description: endpoints, request/response shapes, error codes, versioning; do old app builds still work?

items.name: Data model and migration plan
items.description: new tables/columns, expand-then-contract, backfill, can old code run on new schema?

items.name: Domain rules location
items.description: which business rule lives where (backend domain layer, not route/client)?

items.name: Capacity / volume estimate
items.description: expected requests, launch spike, DB size in 6 months?

items.name: Multi-datacenter N+2 redundancy, sharding, 10x growth plan
items.description: overkill now.

items.name: Field-level exposure / mass assignment
items.description: does the response leak fields; can the client set fields it shouldn't?

items.name: Secrets and tokens
items.description: no secrets in bundle, logs, URLs; tokens stored in secure storage on device?

items.name: Threat model (one paragraph: assets, attackers, abuse cases)
items.description: what would a bad actor try?

items.name: DPIA screening note
items.description: is this high-risk processing (tracking, location, large scale)? Usually "no", write why.

items.name: Feature flag / kill switch
items.description: can we turn it off without a release; when is the flag removed?

items.name: A/B experiment framework
items.description: no traffic to make it meaningful.

items.name: Load test
items.description: only for hot paths or bulk jobs.

items.name: Runbook line
items.description: how to diagnose and fix if it breaks at night?

items.name: On-call rotation, formal error-budget policy, monitoring-the-monitoring.
Budget alert covers it
items.description: is the new spend under an existing budget alert?

items.name: Dynamic font size / no text cut off; gestures have a tap alternative
Longer text
items.description: translated strings fit; plurals, dates, currency via central formatters

items.name: Server-sent text (push, email, SMS) localized by user's language
Changelog / release note line for testers and users
